arm_definitions.A: Build the shared owner/view/body/simulation path; retain the owner explicitly with GC.@preserve during pre/post-GC probes, full geometry scan, field sampling, force measurement and two steps.
arm_definitions.B: Build the same shared path inside a noinline helper; return bodies, simulation, WeakRef and scalar/type metadata only, with no strong owner or DeviceGridSDF return. Force full GC and perform the same post-GC geometry, fields, forces and steps. Run twice in separate Julia processes.
arm_definitions.C: Build the same shared path; a OwnedV16Diagnostic wrapper structurally owns owner, bodies and simulation through the same measurements and two steps.

not_sufficient_alone: a cleared WeakRef without observable divergence
a CUDA error without direct collection evidence
causal_decision_rules.strongly_supported: A/C agree within registered geometry, field and force tolerances; BOTH B replicates have WeakRef alive immediately before forced GC and cleared after it; BOTH B replicates then show the same class of candidate geometry, field, force divergence, or CUDA/lifetime operation error compared with A/C; all other recorded input/backend identities match.
causal_decision_rules.unresolved: A/C controls disagree, a B replicate is non-repeatable/incomplete, the owner clears before the forced-GC bracket, identities differ, or evidence does not meet another registered rule.
causal_decision_rules.weakened: Both B replicates retain the owner through forced GC, or both owners are collected and neither replicate shows an observable post-GC difference from A/C.

claim_scope: implementation-layer owner-lifetime diagnosis only; not W3 primal qualification, target-physics qualification, or a production fix
